title: Red Hat Security Advisory: php security update
description:
PHP is an HTML-embedded scripting language commonly used with the Apache HTTP Server.

Security Fix(es):

* PHP: PHP-FPM: PHP-FPM: Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability via improper URL sanitation (CVE-2026-6735)

* php: PHP-CGI out-of-bounds read and write during PATH_INFO correction (CVE-2026-129538)

* php: Timezone cache use-after-free can lead to remote  code execution (CVE-2026-129496)

* php: PHP-FPM epoll use-after-free can lead to local  privilege escalation (CVE-2026-129291)

* php: PHP-FPM request smuggling through an unread HTTP request body) (CVE-2026-129289)

* php: PHP-FPM status endpoint XSS via unescaped user and script fields) (CVE-2026-129292)

* php: PHAR OpenSSL signature bypass via algorithm downgrade (CVE-2026-128090)

* php: SOAP information disclosure through malformed array dimensions) (CVE-2026-15353)

* php: SOAP use-after-free when processing DTD entity references (CVE-2026-129506)

* php: Partially overwritten session files can lead to remote code execution (CVE-2026-126714)

* php: Mixed-case HTTPS and FTPS URLs can expose data in plaintext (CVE-2026-128064)

* php: Denial of service through folded HTTP response headers (CVE-2026-127960)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
